attributes.description:
This dashboard houses some visualizations for the Kibana CTF! I hope you enjoy this wonderful collection of visualizations that will test your ability to understand how dashboards and visuals work at a deeper level!







{ctf_one_dashboard_to_bring_them_all}

[{"type":"markdown","embeddableConfig":{"content":"# ✨ Welcome to the **Kibana CTF Dashboard** ✨

> ### 🌌 *A world of data, discovery, and delightful distractions awaits...*

Welcome, **analyst**. 🕵️‍♂️

You've arrived at a dashboard **full of wonder and awe** — a carefully crafted collection of visualizations designed to make you explore, experiment, and maybe question *just how much information can hide in plain sight.*

---

## 🔭 Explore. Investigate. Discover.

Take some time to wander through this fascinating dashboard.

Every visualization has a story.
Every data point has a purpose.
Every chart reveals something new.

And sometimes...

**the most interesting things aren't the things you can see.** 👀

---

## 📊 Your Mission

Explore the dashboard.

Interact with the visualizations.

Follow the data.

Look closer.

> 💡 **CTF Tip:**
> Don't just investigate the data.
> **Investigate how the dashboard itself is constructed.**

---

### 🧭 A Little Something to Think About

There is always another layer waiting to be discovered.

[**🔎 Look closer...**](https://kibana-ctf-ftw:5601/{ctf_welcome_to_the_wonderful)

---

## 🚀 Ready?

The dashboards are waiting.

The data is waiting.

**Your investigation begins now.**

> ### *Welcome to the wonderful world of dashboards.* 🌎✨
